name: provider-claims-schema-language-refused
description: A repository configuration whose provider entry claims proto, a language the schema reader inside deadset reads rather than an analyzer process. The run is refused naming the entry's language, because a provider supplies an analyzer of a language whose row runs as a process, and no command can take the reader's place.
pending: the Protocol Buffers schema reader inside deadset, which reads the .proto files and joins the analyzers' binding facts; no deadset release carries it yet.
